title: Redaction sanitize and independent verification
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-security --all-features; document-level sanitize removes Info/XMP, attachments, JavaScript, optional content and thumbnails by full rewrite with a fail-closed residual check, and an independent verifier reparses, re-extracts text, scans bytes and re-derives the category inventory, with a PDFium second reader; SEC-008/SEC-009 stay library until the T-0263 UI promotes them
notes: Security half of the redaction pair, opened but not claimed until T-0237 lands per ADR 0012. Serves O-06 and A-30 alongside T-0237. Adds sanitization around redaction: strip or sanitize document metadata, XMP, embedded thumbnails, annotations, form values, link destinations, optional content and incremental-history remnants that could still carry redacted content, and verify with an independent reader (PDFium extraction plus a raw byte scan) that the removed strings cannot be recovered. Must run after T-0237 because it depends on that removal API; it must not duplicate the text-operator removal logic. Matrix rows stay `library` until the app shell task exposes redaction.
